adjudication.rationale: `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts` adds a new code path that calls `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and directly returns the resulting Promise/Response without any timeout/AbortController, `response.ok`/status check, or try/catch. Since this function is used in token refresh paths (e.g., Google/Office365/Zoom/Lark/etc.), a slow/hung sync endpoint can cause the awaiting request to hang indefinitely, and 4xx/5xx responses are not handled at this wrapper layer (and may not be consistently handled by all callers), potentially stalling refresh-dependent flows.
